arrow.tag_en: given, not derived: the loss grows, locked or not
arrow.tag_zh: 给定的：定不定住，损耗都在涨
arrow.en: That the loss goes on growing is given, not derived: the laws take each step to add to what is used up beyond the count, whether the rule is locked or not. What they prove is that a lock which goes by the lead alone runs the same however much is used up, so it stays while that loss passes every bound. Where it is also given that at each step a larger lead leaves no less used up, no smaller a lead and a rule favouring no less, the course that starts with the larger lead has used up no less at every step.
arrow.zh: “损耗在涨”是给定的，不是推出来的：定律设定每一步都往账外的损耗上再添一份，规则定不定住都一样。证明了的是：只看领先多少的定局，耗掉多少都照原样走，所以它一直在，损耗则越过任何界限。再给定一条：每走一步，领先多的耗掉的不更少，留下的领先不更小，规则的偏向也不更弱；那么起点领先多的那条过程，每一步耗掉的都不更少。
arrow.statement: lock_outlives_loss. Premises: the start is locked (the rule favours and is not above what the update gives at that lead); picking under a favouring rule does not lower the lead; the update is monotone in the lead alone; favouring is kept by any rule not lower; and Accrues: at every lead, every loss and every rule, the loss after a step is at least one more. Conclusion: at every step t the loss is at least t above its start, the course is locked, and neither lead nor rule is below its start. The loss clause is proved from Accrues alone (loss_grows, no lock used); the lock clauses from the lead's own law through join_course (no Accrues used). join_course: with the loss stepping by any function of lead, loss and rule, lead and rule run exactly as under the lead's law alone. window_order_kept. Premises: picking monotone in lead and rule; the loss after a step monotone in lead, loss and rule; the update by lead alone monotone in the lead; what counts the loss reads it from the start until it reaches a bound, monotone in lead and loss and never more favourably than the update by lead alone. Conclusion: of two courses, the one whose start has lead, loss and rule not lower and bound not higher has lead, loss and rule not lower at every step. Neither course is assumed locked. The module lists as not derived 'that any drain grows with a share'.
arrow.why: In every law of the lock the growth of the loss is the hypothesis Accrues, and it is quantified over every configuration and every rule, so it holds locked or not. It is a consequence of nothing there: inside lock_outlives_loss the loss clause and the lock clauses are two independent facts set side by side. The present tag ('while locked, the uncounted loss goes on growing') ties that premise to the lock, and the present sentence leaves out the only law in which what is used up depends on the lead, window_order_kept, where the dependence is again a premise (the drain monotone in lead, loss and rule) and the conclusion is an order between two courses. RuleCapture has no loss in it. Optimum.least_of_room and Web.optimum_ends_beyond do derive the uncounted thing going to its lowest allowed level, but for a best outcome by the rule with room to gain; no theorem joins Locked to Frontier, so they cannot carry an arrow out of the lock (they already carry b2.uncounted > a2.ended). The arrow can stay as 'needs' by the map's own convention for a movement that is itself the given (as in 'taking less, in time' and 'the rest start counting the loss'), provided tag and sentence say the growth is given and say what is proved under it.

steps.say_en: That what a locked rule does not count goes on being used up is given, not derived: the laws take each step to add to that loss, whether the rule is locked or not. What they prove is that a lock which goes by the lead alone runs the same however much is used up. That a larger lead uses up no less is given too, where a law draws on it.
steps.say_zh: 定住的规则不算的东西照旧在被耗掉，这是给定的，不是推出来的：定律设定每一步都往这笔损耗上再添一份，定不定住都一样。证明了的是：只看领先多少的定局，耗掉多少都照原样走。领先多的耗掉的不更少，用到的地方也是给定的。
steps.why: The first sentence as told ('While it is locked, what it does not count goes on being used up') states the premise Accrues as something that happens under the lock, and only then takes it back. In the Lean the growth is assumed at every configuration and rule, locked or not, and the lock is no part of its proof. The step also left out what is proved (join_course: the lock runs the same whatever is used up) and that the lead's bearing on the loss is itself a premise (window_order_kept).

steps.say_en: Once nothing is left that counts the loss, and none comes back, a lock that stands stays for good, provided what is used up never lowers the lead.
steps.say_zh: 算这笔损耗的一个都不剩，也不再回来；只要耗掉的不把领先的份额拉下来，已经立住的定局就从此不变。
steps.why: The step says no more than its arrow's sentence, but both drop a premise of the Lean. closed_stays_closed assumes that under a favouring rule the lead does not fall whatever lies beyond (Raises on the whole configuration); window_locked_after_removal has it by form, the lead stepping by its own law. Without it the step is contradicted by the built case this page itself cites under step 10 (Borne.shapers_left): nothing counts the loss at any step, the course is locked at steps 1 to 3, and the lock is left at step 4 because the loss falls on the lead. The stay at 'Holds itself in place' already says 'and the lead never falls'.

steps.say_en: Where the judging of the rule is set by that same side too, the lock is closed on itself. It stays at every step, however far a loss that makes no difference to anything inside it grows. The account calls this loop the meta-attractor; this is its closed form.
steps.say_zh: 连怎么评这条规则，也由同一方来定：这个定局就合上了。只要损耗影响不到圈里的任何一样，不管它涨到多大，定局每一步都还在。这套理论把这个回路叫作元吸引子；这里是它闭合的形式。
steps.why: 'The loss it does not count' is wider than the box's 'a loss nothing inside reads' and than the Lean (Unread: neither the next lead nor the rule read depends on the loss). A loss the rule does not count can still fall on the lead, and then the lock is left (the same built case, Borne). The new wording also keeps the growth as a 'however far', since the lock's staying is proved for any course of the loss and the growth itself is the given.

Taken as given by the laws (step 3): that what is not counted goes on being used up, whether the rule is locked or not; and, where a law draws on it, that a larger lead uses up no less. No law drawn derives either from the lock.
Only in built examples (steps 4, 16): that what would read the loss is removed.

The way out. Proved of the course itself (step 9; step 8 says what "in time" means): exactly when a loss that has reached what sets the rule in time turns it. Every other way out drawn (steps 10 to 13) is proved only with something given from outside the course: a judging that stops favouring past a set loss, a loss that falls on what shapes the rule, a measure over a fixed list, a limit on what is allowed. No law drawn says what makes a loss reach what sets the rule, or come to be counted. One built case (under step 10) shows a lock left with nothing counting the loss: the loss fell on what the rule favoured.
In no law (steps 17, 18): what first brings a rule to be updated from its own picks, and the loop reaching its own checks.
shows_zh: 已证明的（第 2、5、6、7 步）：定局本身，各在句子里写明的条件之下。
定律当作给定的（第 3 步）：规则不算的东西照旧在被耗掉，定不定住都一样；用到的地方，“领先多的耗掉的不更少”也是给定的。画出的定律里，没有一条把这两点从定局推出来。
只有造出来的例子的（第 4、16 步）：读得到损耗的被清走。

出路。过程自己的定律（第 9 步；第 8 步说的是“及时”指什么）：损耗及时传到定规则的一方之后，恰好在什么条件下规则会转向。其余画出的每一条出路（第 10 到 13 步），都只在有过程之外给定的东西时才得到证明：一种损耗过了定量就不再偏向的评法，落在改规则一方身上的损耗，按一份固定名单来量，对允许结果的一条限制。损耗怎样才传得到定规则的一方、怎样才被算进去，画出的定律里没有一条说。有一个造出来的例子（在第 10 步下面）：没有任何一方去算损耗，定局也破了，因为损耗落在了规则偏向的一方身上。
没有定律的（第 17、18 步）：规则最初怎样变成照自己选出的结果改；这个圈怎样伸到查错的途径上。

written.en: What can still correct a view
written.zh: 看法靠什么纠正，又在哪里纠不动
written.lead_en: A diagnosis, a stock list, a map, a forecast, a model's picture of its task: each is a view of something, and what comes back from that thing can correct it or fail to. This path follows a view from several accounts still open, to checked, to going by how things were, then into two places where it stands whether right or wrong, with what leaving each takes.
written.lead_zh: 诊断、库存单、地图、预报、模型对任务的理解，都是对某样东西的看法；从那样东西回来的结果，有时纠得了它，有时纠不了。这条路跟着一个看法走：从几种说法都还讲得通，到对过了，到还按老样子看，再到两处对也好错也好它都立着的地方，以及从每一处出来要什么。

sections.en: How a view comes to fit, and goes stale

steps.say_en: Several accounts of a thing still fit, and what comes back can tell them apart. Each answer can only remove: an account stays exactly while every later answer bearing on it allows it, and once it is ruled out no later answer brings it back.
steps.say_zh: 对一样东西，还有几种说法都讲得通，回来的结果能把它们分开。每个结果只能排除：一种说法留着，恰好是在往后每个相关的结果都容得下它的时候；一旦排除，往后哪个结果都找不回它。

steps.say_en: Where the thing follows a fixed law through finitely many states, trying repeating patterns and dropping each that misses gives a guess at every step once there have been as many steps as states. The misses are fewer than a bound set by that number, and they do not go on without end.
steps.say_zh: 实情按固定的规律、在有限几种状态之间走：拿“从某一步起循环”的说法一个个试，猜错的就排除。步数到了状态数以后，每一步都有猜测；猜错的次数少于由状态数定的上限，不会没完没了地错下去。

steps.say_en: A view is checked when it has just been set beside the thing itself, where it could have come out otherwise; it fits as of that look. An account on the list that predicts just as the thing answers, throughout a range the thing never leaves, is never dropped.
steps.say_zh: 看法刚和实情对过，而且本来有可能对不上，才算对过了；它对，是就这一次对照说的。单子上的一种说法，在实情始终不离开的一个范围里处处预料得和实情的回应一样，就永远不会被排除。

steps.say_en: A look ages. Where its error grows with its age, it can back an act only while its age is within a bound set by how fast the error grows and how much room is left; past that it backs none.
steps.say_zh: 对照会变旧。误差若是随时间增长，这次对照能支撑行动，只到一个期限为止；期限由误差长得多快、余地还剩多少来定。过了期限，它什么行动都支撑不了。

steps.say_en: A view that goes by how things were was right when it was taken; the thing has changed since, the change did not enter the view, and nothing inside the view shows the difference. Where two histories leave the same view over things that differ, any course of acts that opens no fresh look keeps the view the same in both and the things different.
steps.say_zh: 还按老样子看的看法，形成的时候是对的；后来实情变了，变化没进到看法里，看法自己也显不出差别。两段经历留下同一个看法，实情却不同：只要不重新去看，不管走什么样的步子，两边的看法都还一样，实情也还是不同。

steps.say_en: Where a change is foreseen, every state it could lead to from one still held possible is held possible again, ruled out before or not. While each change is recorded as the kind it is and the reports fit, how things actually are stays among those held possible.
steps.say_zh: 预料到会变：凡是这个变化能从某个还算可能的状态通到的状态，都重新算作可能，先前排除过的也算。只要每次变化都按它实际的那一类记下、报告也都对得上，实际情形就一直在算作可能的里面。

steps.say_en: Or a fresh look is taken against known references. With enough in hand to revise, through channels that are connected and all respond, what follows goes exactly as it would with reports that respond.
steps.say_zh: 或者，拿已知的参照重新对一次。手里有够改的本钱，渠道都接通、都有反应：往后的过程，就和报告如实反应时完全一样。

sections.en: Two places where a view stands, right or wrong
sections.zh: 两处：对也好错也好，看法都立着

steps.say_en: The first place is a known road: what holds the view chooses by the view, and the choice brings back only what the view expected. Where the thing answers the chosen act with the value already received, as every account still kept predicts, and the thing itself stays as it is, it rests from the first step: the same accounts, act and value at every step.
steps.say_zh: 第一处是熟路：持这个看法的一方照看法来选，选出来的又只带回看法料到的结果。实情对它选的动作的回应，就是它已经收到的那个值，也正是它留着的每一种说法所预料的，实情自己又不变：这样它从第一步起就停住，每一步都是同样的说法、同样的动作、同样的值。

steps.say_en: Where each act at a state has one outcome, the record fixes what an act does there if and only if it has been taken there; another act's outcome is fixed only once the course is back at that state and takes it. So a view that is wrong only about what it has not tried fits every step.
steps.say_zh: 每个状态下每个动作只有一种结果时，记录定得出一个动作在那里的结果，恰好是在这个动作在那里做过的时候；别的动作的结果，要等过程回到那个状态、并且做了它，才定得下来。所以只错在没试过的地方的看法，每一步都对得上。

steps.say_en: Whether two states of things look alike to it turns on its own acts: met from one start, they look alike exactly as long as they answer alike the acts it actually takes. At the first answer to such an act that differs, what it takes in differs.
steps.say_zh: 两种情形在它看来一样不一样，要看它自己做了什么：从同一个开头出发，两种情形在它看来一样，恰好是在它们对它实际做出的动作回应都一样的时候。对这样的动作只要有一次回应不同，它收到的就不同了。

steps.say_en: The second place: two states of things that differ give it the same of everything it takes in. From one start, as long as all it takes in agrees, what it holds and what it does agree too, so it acts the same in both.
steps.say_zh: 第二处：两种不同的情形，传到它这里的东西完全一样。从同一个开头出发，只要收到的都一样，它留着的和做的也都一样，所以它在两种情形里做的是同一件事。

steps.say_en: However its trials are chosen, two accounts that every available trial treats alike keep the order they started in. Telling them apart needs a trial that treats them differently, brought in from beyond what it has.
steps.say_zh: 不管怎么挑试验，凡是每一种现有试验都一样对待的两种说法，先后次序都保持原样。要分开它们，得有一种区别对待它们的试验，从它现有的之外带进来。

steps.say_en: In a built process, forming the link that tells two states apart can use up the last unit: it then tells them apart and cannot correct.
steps.say_zh: 一个造出来的过程里：接上能分开两种情形的那个环节，可能把最后一份存量也用掉；这时它分得出来，却改不了。

steps.say_en: With exactly enough for a fresh look and none for the revision, where the references no longer match, the look spends what there was and revises nothing: the reports are not admitted, and what follows is left as it was. A correction can be carried out exactly where the stock covers it and the rest of the process allows it; either can fail alone.
steps.say_zh: 本钱刚好够重新看一次、不够改，参照又已经对不上：这一看把本钱花光，却什么都没改；报告不被采用，往后的一切照旧。一次纠正做得成，恰好是在存量够、其余环节也允许的时候；两样各自都可能不成。

shows_en: Proved, each under the condition its sentence gives (steps 1 to 3, 5 to 8, 11, and the first half of step 14): answers only narrow a view; an account that predicts as the thing answers is never dropped; a view that goes by how things were stays the same through any acts that open no fresh look; two ways back, a change foreseen (step 6) and a fresh look with enough in hand to revise (step 7); rest on the known road; acting the same where all that is taken in agrees; and a look that spends all there was and revises nothing.

Proved boundaries, which say what a thing turns on and show nothing moving (steps 9 and 10, and the second half of step 14): the record fixes only what has been tried; two states look alike exactly while they answer alike the acts actually taken; a correction can be carried out exactly where the stock covers it and the rest of the process allows it.

Proved only with something given from outside the course (steps 4 and 12): step 4 is a necessary condition, with the growth of the error given; step 12 says that telling apart what every available trial treats alike needs a trial brought in from beyond. Only in built examples: step 13, telling two states apart with the last unit, after which it cannot correct; and, under step 9, coming out of the known road only from a different start (begun on the untried act, told which state holds, or listing both outcomes and waiting for the answer).

No arrow drawn leads into either of the two places, and from the known road none leads on except to rest. No law drawn here says what brings a view to foresee a change, to take a fresh look, or to try what it has not tried. How a checked view comes to go by how things were, with nothing showing it, is in built examples only (under step 4): the thing moves while the change is recorded as none, and a check still passes.
shows_zh: 已证明的，各在句子里写明的条件之下（第 1 到 3 步、第 5 到 8 步、第 11 步，以及第 14 步的前一半）：回来的结果只会把看法收窄；预料得和实情一样的说法不会被排除；还按老样子看的看法，只要不重新去看，怎么走都还是那一个；两条回头的路，预料到变化（第 6 步），有余力改的时候重新对一次（第 7 步）；在熟路上停住；收到的都一样，做的也就一样；还有看了一次、本钱花光、什么都没改。

checked.en: What can still correct a view
checked.zh: 看法靠什么纠正，又在哪里纠不动
checked.lead_en: A diagnosis, a stock list, a map, a forecast, a model's picture of its task: each is a view of something, and what comes back from that thing can correct it or fail to. This path follows a view from several accounts still open, to checked, to going by how things were; then two places where it stands whether right or wrong, with what it takes to leave each; and last, where the difference is seen and the means to correct are lacking.
checked.lead_zh: 诊断、库存单、地图、预报、模型对任务的理解，都是对某样东西的看法；从那样东西回来的结果，有时纠得了它，有时纠不了。这条路跟着一个看法走：从几种说法都还讲得通，到对过了，到还按老样子看；再到两处对也好错也好它都立着的地方，和从每一处出来要什么；最后是看出来了，却没本钱改。

sections.en: How a view comes to fit, and goes stale

steps.say_en: Several accounts of a thing still fit, and what comes back can tell them apart. Each answer can only remove: an account stays exactly while every later answer bearing on it allows it, and once it is ruled out no later answer brings it back.
steps.say_zh: 对一样东西，还有几种说法都讲得通，回来的结果能把它们分开。每个结果只能排除：一种说法留着，恰好是在往后每个相关的结果都容得下它的时候；一旦排除，往后哪个结果都找不回它。

steps.say_en: Where the thing follows a fixed law through finitely many states, trying repeating patterns and dropping each that misses gives a guess at what comes next at every step, once there have been as many steps as states. The misses are fewer than a bound set by that number, and they do not go on without end.
steps.say_zh: 实情按固定的规律、在有限几种状态之间走：拿“从某一步起循环”的说法一个个试，猜错的就排除。步数到了状态数以后，每一步都有一个对下一步的猜测；猜错的次数少于由状态数定的上限，不会没完没了地错下去。

steps.say_en: A view is checked when it has just been set beside the thing itself, where it could have come out otherwise; it fits as of that look. An account on the list that predicts just as the thing answers, throughout a range the thing never leaves, is never dropped.
steps.say_zh: 看法刚和实情对过，而且本来有可能对不上，才算对过了；它对，是就这一次对照说的。单子上的一种说法，在实情始终不离开的一个范围里处处预料得和实情的回应一样，就永远不会被排除。

steps.say_en: A look ages. Where its error grows with its age, it can back an act only while its age is within a bound set by how fast the error grows and how much room for error is left; past that it backs none.
steps.say_zh: 对照会变旧。误差若是随时间增长，这次对照能支撑行动，只到一个期限为止；期限由误差长得多快、余地还剩多少来定。过了期限，它什么行动都支撑不了。

steps.say_en: A view that goes by how things were was right when it was taken; the thing has changed since, the change did not enter the view, and nothing inside the view shows the difference. Where two histories leave the same view over things that differ, any course of acts that opens no fresh look keeps the view the same in both and leaves the things as they were, still different.
steps.say_zh: 还按老样子看的看法，形成的时候是对的；后来实情变了，变化没进到看法里，看法自己也显不出差别。两段经历留下同一个看法，实情却不同：只要不重新去看，接着不管做什么，两边的看法都还一样；实情也原样没动，还是不同。

steps.say_en: Where a change is foreseen, every state it could lead to from one still held possible is held possible, ruled out before or not. While each change is recorded as the kind it is and the reports fit, how things actually are stays among those held possible.
steps.say_zh: 预料到会变：凡是这个变化能从某个还算可能的状态通到的状态，都算作可能，先前排除过的也算。只要每次变化都按它实际的那一类记下、报告也都对得上，实际情形就一直在算作可能的里面。

steps.say_en: Or a fresh look is taken against known references. With enough in hand to revise, through channels that are connected and all respond, what follows goes exactly as it would with reports that answer to what actually happens.
steps.say_zh: 或者，拿已知的参照重新对一次。手里有够改的本钱，渠道都接通、都有反应：往后的过程，就和报告如实反映实际结果时完全一样。

sections.en: Two places where a view stands, right or wrong
sections.zh: 两处：对也好错也好，看法都立着

steps.say_en: The first place is the known road: whatever holds the view chooses by the view, and the choice brings back only what the view expected. Where the thing answers the chosen act with the value already received, as every account still kept predicts, and the thing itself does not change, it rests from the first step: the same accounts, act and value at every step.
steps.say_zh: 第一处是熟路：持这个看法的一方照看法来选，选出来的又只带回看法料到的结果。实情对它选的动作的回应，就是它已经收到的那个值，也正是它留着的每一种说法所预料的，实情自己又不变：这样它从第一步起就停住，每一步都是同样的说法、同样的动作、同样的值。

steps.say_en: Where each act at a state has one outcome, the record fixes what an act does there exactly when it has been taken there; another act's outcome is fixed only once the course is back at that state and takes it. So a view that is wrong only about what has not been tried fits every step.
steps.say_zh: 每个状态下每个动作只有一种结果时，记录定得出某个动作在某个状态下的结果，恰好是在这个动作在那里做过的时候；别的动作的结果，要等过程回到那个状态、并且做了它，才定得下来。所以，只错在没试过的地方的看法，每一步都对得上。

steps.say_en: Whether two states of things look alike to it turns on its own acts: met from one start, they look alike exactly as long as they answer alike the acts it actually takes. At the first answer to such an act that differs, what it takes in differs.
steps.say_zh: 两种情形在它看来一样不一样，要看它自己做了什么：从同一个开头出发，两种情形在它看来一样，恰好是在它们对它实际做出的动作回应都一样的时候。对这样的动作只要有一次回应不同，它收到的就不同了。

steps.say_en: The second place: two states of things that differ give it the same of everything it takes in. Starting the same in both, as long as all it takes in agrees, what it holds and what it does agree too, so it acts the same in both.
steps.say_zh: 第二处：两种不同的情形，传到它这里的东西完全一样。它自己从同一个开头出发，只要收到的都一样，它留着的和做的也都一样，所以它在两种情形里做的是同一件事。

steps.say_en: However its trials are chosen, two accounts that every available trial treats alike keep the order they started in: whichever was given more weight at the start still has more. Telling them apart needs a trial that treats them differently, brought in from beyond what it has.
steps.say_zh: 不管怎么挑试验，凡是每一种现有试验都一样对待的两种说法，原来哪一种分量重，试过之后还是哪一种重。要分开它们，得有一种区别对待它们的试验，从它现有的之外带进来。

steps.say_en: In a built process, forming the link that tells two states apart can use up the last unit: it then tells them apart and cannot correct.
steps.say_zh: 一个造出来的过程里：接上能分开两种情形的那个环节，可能把最后一份存量也用掉；这时它分得出来，却改不了。

steps.say_en: With exactly enough for a fresh look and none for the revision, where the references no longer match, the look spends what there was and revises nothing: the reports are not admitted, and what follows is left as it was. A correction can be carried out exactly where the stock covers it and the rest of the process allows it; either can fail alone.
steps.say_zh: 本钱刚好够重新看一次、不够改，参照又已经对不上：这一看把本钱花光，却什么都没改；报告不被采用，往后的一切照旧。一次纠正做得成，恰好是在存量够、其余环节也允许的时候；两样里任何一样都可能单独落空。

shows_en: Proved, each under the condition its sentence gives (steps 1 to 3, 5 to 8, 11, and the first half of step 14): answers only narrow a view; where the thing follows a fixed law through finitely many states, the misses of trying and dropping stay under a bound; an account that predicts as the thing answers is never dropped; two histories that left the same view over things that differ still have the same view after any acts that open no fresh look; two ways back along the row, a change foreseen, from a checked view (step 6), and a fresh look with enough in hand to revise, from a view that goes by how things were (step 7); rest on the known road; acting the same where all that is taken in agrees; and a look that spends all there was and revises nothing.

Proved boundaries, which say what a thing turns on and show nothing moving (steps 9 and 10, and the second half of step 14): the record fixes only what has been tried, so a view wrong only about what has not been tried fits every step; two states look alike exactly while they answer alike the acts actually taken; a correction can be carried out exactly where the stock covers it and the rest of the process allows it.

Proved only with something given from outside the course (steps 4 and 12): step 4 is a necessary condition, with the growth of the error given; step 12 says that telling apart what every available trial treats alike needs a trial brought in from beyond. Only in built examples: step 13, telling two states apart with the last unit, after which it cannot correct; and, under step 9, coming out of the known road only from a different start (begun on the untried act, told which state holds, or listing both outcomes and waiting for the answer).

No arrow drawn leads into either of the two places, and from the known road none leads on except to rest. No law drawn here says what brings a view to foresee a change, to take a fresh look, or to try what it has not tried. How a checked view comes to go by how things were, with nothing showing it, is in built examples only (under step 4): the thing moves while the change is recorded as none, and a check still passes.

written.zh: 有来有往：怎么断，怎么续
written.lead_en: Neighbours lend because the last loan came back, a workshop delivers because its supplier did, a craft is still practised because each master taught the next. This path follows such giving: how it keeps going round, how one lapse can end it, what starts it again, and whether it lasts once what carries it is replaced.
written.lead_zh: 邻居肯借，是因为上回借出去的还回来了；作坊交得出货，是因为上家先交了；一门手艺还在，是因为师傅带出了徒弟。这条路跟着这样的“给”走：它怎么转得下去，一处不给怎么就全停了，停了靠什么接上，给的换了一茬以后它还在不在。

steps.say_en: Each gives because what it waits on gave, so the giving carries itself on. A group that is giving at the start, each member waiting on no more outside the group than it can do without, gives at every step, whatever the rest do.
steps.say_zh: 各自都是所等的给了才给，给就这样接下去。一开始都在给的一群，各自在群外等的不超过自己少得起的，那么不管其余的怎样，这一群每一步都照给。

steps.say_en: What a lapse does turns on how long it is. Where all were giving and each waits a set number of steps before answering: a shorter lapse passes, each giving at every step but its own lapses; a lapse as long as the wait is answered at the next step by all that wait on it, which hold back.
steps.say_zh: 一次中断会怎样，看它有多长。从全都在给出发，各自都要等满固定的几步才回应：比这短的中断过得去，各自除了自己中断的那几步都照给；中断长到这个步数，下一步等着它的就全都不给。

steps.say_en: Where each gives only if it gave at the step before and all it waits on gave too, one lapse stops everything it can reach along the waits, each within as many steps as the chain of waits to it is long. None of those gives again.
steps.say_zh: 要是各自都得自己上一步给过、所等的也全给了才给：有一个不给，顺着“等”够得着的都跟着停，隔着几环，就在几步之内停下。停了的不再给。

steps.say_en: In a pair, where each side's way of giving keeps holding back once both have held back two steps running: if both lapse at the same two steps in a row, all giving ends for good, whatever lapses come after.
steps.say_zh: 两方之间，要是双方的给法都是“两边连着两步都没给，就接着不给”：只要有接连两步双方都没给成，从此两边都不再给，后面再出不出差错都一样。

steps.say_en: Nothing gives, because each gives only after another has. Where each needs at least one of those it waits on to have given, or each gives only if it gave before, nothing given at one step means nothing given at any later step.
steps.say_zh: 全都不给了：各自都在等别的先给。要是哪一个都至少要等到一个它所等的给了才给，或者各自都得自己上一步给过才给：某一步全都不给，以后每一步也全都不给。

steps.say_en: A lapse is passed over where each can do without as many of those it waits on as have lapsed: at the next step all give.
steps.say_zh: 一处不给，也可以就这么过去：各自少得起的个数，不比它所等的里面断掉的少，下一步就全都照给。

steps.say_en: Where each gives as soon as all it waits on gave: if every chain of waits is shorter than some length, all give after that many steps. Round a loop of waits a lapse never dies out: it comes back at every turn.
steps.say_zh: 要是各自只要所等的上一步都给了就给：一串串的“等”都短于某个长度，过了那么多步就全都在给。“等”要是连成一圈，中断不会消失，每绕一圈回来一次。

steps.say_en: Once nothing is given, giving comes back only if something gives without waiting. Where some do and the rest give as soon as all they wait on gave, all give from a given step on, whatever the start, exactly when no chain of that many waits avoids those that give without waiting.
steps.say_zh: 全都不给以后，只有出现不等就给的，给才回得来。有了这样的，其余的又是所等的都给了就给：不论从哪里起步，从某一步起全都在给，恰好是在没有那么长的一串“等”绕得开它们的时候。

sections.en: Over a longer time: handed on, or gone
sections.zh: 时间再长：传下去，还是没了

steps.say_en: A pattern can go on while what carries it is replaced. Where it is carried only by being handed on, a pattern that lasts is handed on at least once in every stretch as long as one carrier lasts.
steps.say_zh: 承载它的换了一茬又一茬，同一个格局可以还在。要是它只靠传给才有新的承载，那么只要它一直在，每过一茬那么长的时间，至少往下传了一次。

steps.say_en: Where handing on stops, such a pattern is gone within one carrier's span. So with a rule taught only by those that hold it: if holders leave before they can teach, or the number let in is set to nothing and not raised again, no holder is left after one term.
steps.say_zh: 不再往下传，这样的格局在一茬的时间之内就没了。只由持守的成员来教的规则就是这样：持守的还没到能教的年头就退了，或者收新的名额改成零、再没改回来，过一任就一个持守的都不剩。

steps.say_en: Where whatever carries a pattern either carried it before or was handed it, a step with no carrier is followed by none. Once gone, it comes back only where something starts carrying it without being handed it.
steps.say_zh: 要是凡承载这个格局的，不是原先就承载着，就是被传给的：有一步一个承载的都没有，以后也一直没有。没了以后再要有，只能是有什么不经传给、自己开始承载它。

shows_en: Proved, each under the way of giving its sentence names (steps 1 to 7): when giving that goes round keeps going, when a lapse passes or is passed over, when one lapse stops all it can reach, and that once nothing is given nothing is given later. No law drawn here says which way of giving is in use, or how one comes to be.
Proved only with something given from outside (step 8): from nothing given, giving comes back only through something that gives without waiting. No law drawn here says what would make anything do so.

Over a longer time (steps 9 to 11): that a lasting pattern carried only by being handed on is handed on within every carrier's span, and is gone within one span where handing on stops, is proved (steps 9, 10). Its return (step 11) is proved only with something given from outside: something that starts carrying it without being handed it.

No step rests on a built example or a reading. No arrow drawn joins giving that goes round to being handed on; the path sets the two side by side. Steps 8 and 11 have the same shape: what has stopped everywhere starts again only through something that begins without first being given to.

要靠过程之外给定的东西的（第 8 步）：全都不给以后，只有出现不等就给的，给才回得来。是什么让哪一个不等就给，这里画出的定律没有说。
时间再长（第 9 到 11 步）：只靠传给来承载的格局，只要还在，每一茬之内都往下传过；不再传，一茬之内就没了。这两条已证明（第 9、10 步）。没了以后再有（第 11 步），要靠过程之外给定的东西：有什么不经传给就自己开始承载。
这条路上没有哪一步靠的是造出来的例子或者解读。“有来有往”和“一茬传一茬”之间，图上没有画箭头；这条路只是把两者并排放着。第 8 步和第 11 步是同一个样子：处处都停了的，只有靠一个不等别的先给的，才重新开始。

written.lead_en: A microphone that picks up its own loudspeaker, a shower tap turned back and forth, a debt that bears interest on interest: what is done travels on, and sometimes comes back to where it began. This path follows one difference sent out, a little more or less than there would otherwise be: whether it comes back at all, and whether each turn returns less of it, the same, or more.
written.lead_zh: 话筒收到自己音箱的声音，淋浴的龙头拧过来又拧过去，欠的债利滚利：做出去的事往下传，有时又绕回原处。这条路跟着送出去的一点差别走，也就是比本来多出或少掉的那一点：它回不回得来；回得来的话，每转一圈是少了，原样，还是多了。

steps.say_en: What something does is passed on down the line, and no chain of effects leads back to it.
steps.say_zh: 做出去的只往下游传，没有哪条因果的链子绕回来。

steps.say_en: A line closes into a ring at exactly the step where something acting then answers to a level downstream of what it gives to. In built examples, the amounts before that step show no sign of it.
steps.say_zh: 链子合成圈，恰在这样一步：这一步有个起作用的环节，它给出多少，要看它所给之处下游的某个存量。在造出来的例子里，这一步之前的数量看不出任何迹象。

steps.say_en: Whether a link goes on acting turns on one thing. Fed at every step from a level that stands, and weakening with what it has carried, it stops for good exactly where its response reaches nothing at some amount; otherwise it keeps acting, and more passes at every step.
steps.say_zh: 一个环节会不会停下，只看一条。它每一步都由一个一直不空的存量供着，传过去的越多，回应只减不增：恰在传到某个量、回应降到零的时候，它从此不再起作用；否则它一直起作用，每一步都有更多的经过它。

sections.en: Where each turn brings back less

steps.say_en: A difference going round gets smaller only through a link that passes on less than it got. Where every turn returns less than was sent, and nothing for nothing, the difference is gone within as many turns as its size, and stays gone.
steps.say_zh: 绕着圈走的差别要变小，只能是经过了一个传出去比收到少的环节。每转一圈回来的都比送出去的少，没有差别送出去就没有差别回来：那么差别有多大，至多转那么多圈就没了，此后一直没有。

steps.say_en: Where a level is pushed back toward a mark: once every push is against the departure and no larger than the gap, at every step, the level is at its mark within as many steps as the gap was wide, and stays there.
steps.say_zh: 一个水平被往它该在的那个点推：从某一步起，每一步的推回都朝着偏离的反方向，又不超过缺口，那么缺口有多宽，至多那么多步，水平就回到那个点，从此停在那里。

steps.say_en: Where a turn returns no less for a larger difference than for a smaller, and does not raise the one it starts from, the difference never rises; within as many turns as its size it settles where a turn leaves it unchanged. Once there, it stays at every later turn: under one fixed law nothing inside moves it on.
steps.say_zh: 转一圈，大的差别回来的不比小的少，起头的那个差别又没有被抬高：那么差别永不上升，它有多大，至多转那么多圈，就停在转一圈也不变的地方。到了那里，此后每一圈都停着：规律不变，里面就没有什么再推动它。

sections.en: Where it brings back as much, or more

steps.say_en: Where each link passes on exactly what it gets, the difference comes back whole at every turn: no turn closes it and none grows it.
steps.say_zh: 圈上每个环节收多少就传多少，差别每转一圈都原样回来：哪一圈都不合上它，也不把它变大。

steps.say_en: A ring that returns nothing for nothing can close a difference only by taking two differences to one, and those two then go on as one. Where every difference comes round again, no two are taken to one and none is closed.
steps.say_zh: 一个没有差别进去就没有差别回来的圈，要合上一个差别，只能是把两个不同的差别变成同一个，此后这两个一直是同一个。每个差别都转得回来的地方，没有哪两个被并成一个，也就没有哪个被合上。

steps.say_en: Where every link passes on at least twice what it gets, the difference passes every bound: after ten turns it is at least a thousand times what it started as. Where the links multiply by whole numbers nothing lies in between: multiplied together they close the difference in one turn, keep it as it is, or grow it.
steps.say_zh: 圈上每个环节传出去的都至少是收到的两倍，差别就越过任何界限：转十圈，至少是起初的一千倍。环节都按整数倍传的时候，没有中间的情形：各环节的倍数乘起来，是零，一圈就合上；是一，原样留着；二以上，越滚越大。

steps.say_en: Growing on itself without end needs room without end. Among finitely many states under one fixed law, every course is, before as many steps as there are states, at a state it comes back to; staying put counts.
steps.say_zh: 要无止境地越滚越大，得有无止境的余地。状态只有有限几种、规律又不变的时候，每条过程在步数达到状态的个数之前，就已经处在一个它还会再回来的状态上；停着不动也算回来。

sections.en: Too far, too late, never enough

steps.say_en: A push back carries the level past its mark exactly when it exceeds the gap. Where it exceeds the gap at every step, the level crosses the mark for ever and is never on it.
steps.say_zh: 回推把水平带过那个点，恰在它超过缺口的时候。每一步的回推都超过缺口，水平就永远来回越过那个点，从不落在点上。

steps.say_en: The later a correction reads the level, the wider the narrowest band it can hold against every disturbance that moves the level by no more than a set amount each step. A fixed-step correction that reads late settles in its band exactly where the band holds what it pushes during the delay; otherwise there is a start below the band from which the level swings beyond both ends without end.
steps.say_zh: 扰动每步挪动不超过某个量：纠正读得越晚，它守得住的最窄范围就越宽。按固定步子纠正、读数又来得晚的：恰在范围容得下延迟期间推出去的量时，水平才停在范围之内；否则就有从范围下方出发的起点，从那里出发，水平在范围两头之外来回摆，没有止境。

steps.say_en: Where the mark is more than now, or where two or more each have as their mark to stand above all the rest, nothing it could stay at meets the mark.
steps.say_zh: 要的若是“比现在多”，或者两个以上各自都要压过其余所有的，那么停在哪里都达不到。

steps.say_en: A search that only stays or moves to what scores higher, on a score with a ceiling, is at rest from every start within one step more than that ceiling; at rest, a mark of more than now is unmet. Where what stands can be listed and runs down at every step from some point on, no level goes on rising at ever later steps: from running out, not from having enough.
steps.say_zh: 一个只会停着不动、或者走到得分更高处的搜索，分数有上限的时候，从任何起点出发，至多比上限多一步就停下；停下的地方，达不到“比现在多”。存着的东西数得过来，又从某一刻起每一步都在减少，就没有哪个水平能越来越晚地一再上涨：那是用完了，不是够了。

shows_en: Proved of the course itself, each under the condition its sentence gives (steps 2, 4 to 7, 9, 10 and 14): the step at which a line closes into a ring, and what becomes of a difference by what each turn returns: gone, settled, kept whole, or grown past every bound. What is said of staying at rest, growing, swinging and having nowhere to rest (in steps 6, 9 and 11 to 14) is proved too.

Proved boundaries (steps 3, 11 and 12): each says what a thing turns on (whether a link's response falls to nothing, whether a push exceeds the gap, whether the band holds what is pushed during the delay), not what moves anything across.

A necessary condition only (step 8): a difference is closed only by taking two to one; no law here says what brings that about. From built examples only: the second sentence of step 2, that the amounts beforehand show no sign of a ring closing. No step is a reading.

What no law drawn here shows: what makes a ring return less, as much or more, and what brings a link to answer to what lies downstream of it; the laws take both as given. No arrow drawn leads into swinging or into having nowhere to rest, and none leads out of swinging: how these begin and end is not on the map.
shows_zh: 过程自己的定律，各在句子里写明的条件之下（第 2、4 到 7、9、10、14 步）：链子在哪一步合成圈；绕着圈走的差别，按每一圈回来多少，是没了、停住、原样留着，还是越过任何界限。讲到停住、越滚越大、来回摆、怎么都不算够时“留在那里会怎样”的几句（第 6、9、11 到 14 步里），也已证明。
已证明的界线（第 3、11、12 步）：说的是事情看什么而定（环节的回应降不降到零，回推超不超过缺口，范围容不容得下延迟期间推出去的量），没有说是什么把它推过界线。
只是必要条件的（第 8 步）：要合上一个差别，只能把两个并成一个；是什么促成这一点，这里没有定律说。只来自造出来的例子的：第 2 步的后一句，圈合上之前数量上看不出迹象。没有哪一步是解读。
这里画出的定律没有说的：一个圈转一圈，回来的为什么是少、是原样、还是多；一个环节怎么会开始看它下游的存量。这两点定律都当作给定的。通向“来回摆，停不住”和“怎么都不算够”的箭头一条也没有画出，从“来回摆，停不住”出去的也没有：它们怎么开始、怎么结束，图上还没有。

FOUND WRONG OR DOUBTFUL WHILE READING
1. e2.round>e2.rest is kind "line" but is not a two-sided boundary. One half is a double negation under conditions (World.comes_to_rest_unrefuted: listed, enclosed, each taker gives back less; "cannot be refuted"); the other half is one built net (Net.cycle_never_rests is a specific witness: "a built cycle"). An unmarked step on it would announce a built example as a proved boundary, and the tag "is anything lost on the way round?" promises an exact line the laws do not give. Suggest: main sentence law (the with-loss half), the built cycle as a "more" of kind built; or kind built.
2. e1.ring>e2.rest: the tag "each turn returns no more" drops the condition the law needs. LoopReturn.never_rises/settles_within need the turn to keep order (no less back for a larger difference) and not to raise the starting difference only; the tag reads as "returns no more for every difference", which is neither needed nor enough. Suggested tag: "a turn keeps order and does not raise the start" / "转一圈不乱大小，也不抬高起点".
3. e1.line>e1.ring is kind law but its sentence is an "if, and only if" for the step a ring forms (onLoop_succ_iff); no law says what brings a link to answer downstream. The tag "a link comes to answer to what lies downstream" reads as a movement with a cause. I told it as "exactly the step where" and said in the shows lines that what brings it about is taken as given. Its second sentence is built-only (Closing.Onset.unforeseen, Thresholds.Draw.forms_at_break) inside a law sentence; fine as worded ("In built cases"), but the arrow has one reader only.
4. e1.ring>e2.good lands in a box worded for a level held to a mark (Flow.Opposes/WithinGap), while the arrow's laws are about a return map closing a difference (LoopReturn.closes_within). The Lean ties the two only where the exchanges respond to the gap by a map (LoopReturn.RespondsByReturn, taken as given). So I told steps 4 and 5 apart and did not say they are the same thing; the map draws them as one box.
5. e2.grow>e2.round ("room runs out"): Law.enters_returning_within says every course in a finite world is soon at a state it comes back to, staying put included; that state may be a rest, so the arrow's target could as well be "At rest". The sentence is right; the drawing picks one of two landings.
6. e2.good>e2.swing (one reader): the sentence drops side conditions of Regulation.relay_threshold (band not empty with a positive lower end, positive step, and the push over the delay no more than the band's upper end plus one) and the start that swings is the one held just below the band for the first steps (held_oscillates), not any start below. I wrote "there is a start below the band".
7. Box e2.grow says "comes back larger than it left"; the laws drawn into it need every link at least doubling, or whole-number factors with product two or more. The box sentence is wider than its arrows.

checked.lead_en: A microphone that picks up its own loudspeaker, a shower tap turned back and forth, a debt that bears interest on interest: what is done travels on, and sometimes comes back to where it began. This path follows one difference sent out, a little more or less than there would otherwise be: whether it comes back at all, and whether each turn returns less of it, the same, or more.
checked.lead_zh: 话筒收到自己音箱的声音，淋浴的龙头拧过来又拧过去，欠的债利滚利：做出去的事往下传，有时又绕回原处。这条路跟着送出去的一点差别走，也就是比本来多出或少掉的那一点：它回不回得来；回得来的话，每转一圈是少了，原样，还是多了。

steps.say_en: Along a line, what a thing does is only passed on downstream: no chain of effects leads back to it.
steps.say_zh: 在一条链上，做出去的只往下游传：没有哪条因果的链子绕回来。

steps.say_en: A line closes into a ring at exactly the step where something then acting responds to a level that lies downstream of what it gives to. In built examples, the amounts before that step show no sign of it.
steps.say_zh: 链子合成圈，恰在这样一步：这一步有个起作用的环节，它给出多少，要看它所给之处下游的某个存量。在造出来的例子里，这一步之前的数量看不出任何迹象。

steps.say_en: Whether a link goes on acting turns on one thing. Fed at every step from a stock that is never empty, and responding no more strongly the more it has carried, it stops for good exactly where its response falls to nothing at some amount carried; otherwise it keeps acting, and more passes at every step.
steps.say_zh: 一个环节会不会停下，只看一条。它每一步都由一个一直不空的存量供着，传过去的越多，回应只减不增：回应若在某个量上降到零，它就从此不再起作用；在哪个量上都不到零，它就一直起作用，每一步都有新的传过去。

sections.en: Where each turn brings back less

steps.say_en: A difference going round gets smaller only through a link that passes on less than it got. Where every turn returns less than was sent, and nothing for nothing, the difference is gone within as many turns as its size, and stays gone.
steps.say_zh: 绕着圈走的差别要变小，只能是经过了一个传出去比收到少的环节。每转一圈，回来的都比送出去的少，送出去的是零，回来的也是零：那么差别有多大，至多转那么多圈就没了，此后一直没有。

steps.say_en: For a level off its mark: where, from some step on, every push is back toward the mark and no larger than the gap, the level is at its mark within as many steps as the gap was wide, and stays there.
steps.say_zh: 一个水平偏离了定好的那个点：从某一步起，每一步的推回都朝着那个点，又不超过缺口，那么缺口有多宽，至多那么多步，水平就回到那个点，从此停在那里。

steps.say_en: Where a turn returns no less for a larger difference than for a smaller, and does not raise the one it starts from, the difference never rises; within as many turns as its size it settles where a turn leaves it unchanged. Once there, it stays at every later turn: while a turn goes on working the same way, nothing inside moves it on.
steps.say_zh: 转一圈，大的差别回来的不比小的少，起头的那个差别又没有被抬高：那么差别永不上升，它有多大，至多转那么多圈，就停在转一圈也不变的地方。到了那里，此后每一圈都停着：规律不变，里面就没有什么再推动它。

sections.en: Where it brings back as much, or more

steps.say_en: Where each link passes on exactly what it gets, the difference comes back whole at every turn: no turn closes it and none grows it.
steps.say_zh: 圈上每个环节收多少就传多少，差别每转一圈都原样回来：哪一圈都不消掉它，也不把它变大。

steps.say_en: A ring that returns nothing for nothing can close a difference only by sending two different differences to the same one; those two then go on as one. In such a ring, where every difference comes round again, no two are sent to one and none is closed.
steps.say_zh: 一个圈，送进去的是零、回来的也是零：它要消掉一个差别，只能是把两个不同的差别变成同一个，此后这两个一直是同一个。在这样的圈上，每个差别若都转得回来，就没有哪两个被并成一个，也就没有哪个被消掉。

steps.say_en: Where every link passes on at least twice what it gets, the difference passes every bound: after ten turns it is at least a thousand times what it started as. Where the links multiply by whole numbers there is nothing in between: if the numbers multiplied together come to nothing, the difference is closed in one turn; if to one, it is kept as it is; if to two or more, it passes every bound.
steps.say_zh: 圈上每个环节传出去的都至少是收到的两倍，差别就越过任何界限：转十圈，至少是起初的一千倍。环节都按整数倍传的时候，没有中间的情形：各环节的倍数乘起来，是零，一圈就消掉；是一，原样留着；二以上，越滚越大。

steps.say_en: Growing on itself without end needs room without end. Among finitely many states, where the same state is always followed by the same next one, every course is, before as many steps as there are states, at a state it comes back to; staying put counts.
steps.say_zh: 要无止境地越滚越大，得有无止境的余地。状态只有有限几种、规律又不变的时候，每条过程在步数达到状态的个数之前，就已经处在一个它还会再回来的状态上；停着不动也算回来。

sections.en: Too far, too late, never enough

steps.say_en: A push back carries the level past its mark exactly when it exceeds the gap. Where it exceeds the gap at every step, the level goes on crossing the mark, from one side to the other, and is never on it.
steps.say_zh: 往回推会不会把水平带过那个点，只看推的量超不超过缺口：超过，就带过去；不超过，就不会。每一步都超过缺口，水平就永远来回越过那个点，从不落在点上。

steps.say_en: The later a correction reads the level, the wider the band it needs: against every disturbance that moves the level by no more than a set amount a step, the narrowest band it can keep grows with each step of delay. A correction that pushes by a fixed step and reads late settles in its band, from every start held below it, exactly where the band holds what it pushes during the delay; otherwise there is a start below the band from which the level swings beyond both ends without end.
steps.say_zh: 纠正读得越晚，需要的范围就越宽：面对每一步挪动水平不超过某个量的各种扰动，它守得住的最窄范围随晚的步数增加。按固定步子推、读数又来得晚的纠正：范围容得下延迟期间推出去的量，从范围下方出发的水平就都会停进范围里；容不下，就有一个范围下方的起点，从那里出发，水平在范围两头之外来回摆，没有止境。

steps.say_en: Where the mark is more than now, nothing at rest meets it. Where each of two or more is to stand above all the rest, nothing at rest lets all of them do so.
steps.say_zh: 要的若是“比现在多”，停在哪里都达不到。两个以上各自都要压过其余所有的，停在哪里都不能让它们全都达到。

steps.say_en: A search that only stays or moves to what scores higher, on a score with a ceiling, is at rest from every start within one step more than that ceiling; at rest, a mark of more than now is unmet. Where all that is left can be listed and, from some point on, runs down at every step, no level rises again and again for ever: that is from running out, not from having enough.
steps.say_zh: 一个只会停着不动、或者走到得分更高处的搜索，分数有上限的时候，从任何起点出发，至多比上限多一步就停下；停下的地方，达不到“比现在多”。剩下的东西数得过来，又从某一刻起每一步都在减少，就没有哪个水平能一涨再涨、没有尽头：那是用完了，不是够了。

names.reading: "No live law states this"; the account has "not the loop: the one-sided case", where "that branch has no recovery threshold at all: the account's irreversible limit, not a band".

names.en: Jonas, The Phenomenon of Life: metabolism and needful freedom
names.zh: 约纳斯：代谢与“有所需的自由”
names.reading: The structural half has the form of "a member rebuilt from the level whose 'stock buys it time' and whose 'end does not come back'"; "inwardness and concern are not read off metabolism".

names.en: Fixes that fail (Senge, The Fifth Discipline)
names.zh: 适得其反的修补（圣吉系统基模）
names.reading: One part carried is "a switch keeping a formation active while what sustains it ends"; "none is a fix repeated, and no law says better or worse here".

names.en: Josiah and the law found in the temple (2 Kings 22-23)
names.zh: 约西亚王在圣殿寻回律法书
names.reading: "A rule no living member holds can return only from outside the members"; reading the stored scroll as that outside teacher "is my mapping".

names.en: The Matthew effect: cumulative advantage (Merton)
names.zh: 马太效应：优势累积
names.reading: Cumulative advantage has a shape: "the share rises strictly while the margin is positive and the margin does not fall"; Merton's own claim about misallocated credit "has no form".

names.en: Fisherian runaway: a preference carried along with what it prefers (Fisher; Lande)
names.zh: 费希尔失控选择：偏好随所偏好者一同扩散
names.reading: "A rule read monotonically from the share it selects locks", and a critical mass divides two locks, yet the rule "is read, not inherited through a covariance": "agreement of loop shape only".

names.en: Olson, The Logic of Collective Action: a shared benefit does not select those who pay for it
names.zh: 奥尔森：集体行动的逻辑
names.reading: "At a step a part reaching every member alike leaves the direction where it is"; across a stretch it can turn the verdict, "so the universal form narrows".

names.en: Stigler: regulatory capture, regulation acquired by the regulated
names.zh: 施蒂格勒：规制俘获
names.reading: "Those who shape a rule pay c and receive s alone, selected at a step exactly where c is at most s"; staffing "moves the premise and does not remove it".

names.en: 《左傳·襄公三十一年》子產不毀鄉校 (Zichan keeps the village school where the government is judged)
names.zh: 《左传》：子产不毁乡校
names.reading: "In time and too late are separated by at most one step", and 子產's 「吾不克救也」 "is the far side of it": "hearing late is not hearing".

names.en: Collingridge's dilemma of control (The Social Control of Technology, 1980)
names.zh: 科林格里奇困境
names.reading: "Once the late reading favours the shapers a reading keeps the lock; that the need is read late is supposed", so "the theorem does not correct him".

names.en: Goodhart's law
names.zh: 古德哈特定律
names.reading: "A proxy selects only through what couples in, and with room every optimum of an order rising with it stands least beyond"; "that scopes the popular wording, not his regularity".

names.en: 《禮記·大學》「與其有聚斂之臣，寧有盜臣」 (better a minister who steals than one who gathers revenue)
names.zh: 《大学》：与其有聚敛之臣，宁有盗臣
names.reading: "The collector optimizes the house's take, and what he drains falls beyond what the house reads, on those it lives on. 寧有盗臣 prefers a loss the house reads to one it does not."

names.en: 《國語·周語上》邵公諫厲王弭謗：「國人莫敢言」 (the king silences his critics and reads the silence as success)
names.zh: 《国语》：厉王弭谤，国人莫敢言
names.reading: "Read off the pool its own course leaves, a selection registers no removal ... The king read off the survivors; 邵公 read off the fixed pool."

names.en: 《尚書·酒誥》「人無於水監，當於民監」 (look not in water for a mirror, but in the people)
names.zh: 《尚书·酒诰》：人无于水监，当于民监
names.reading: "The water is a loop that reads only its own share", and "a mirror changed but still of water turns nothing".

names.en: Sen: adaptive preferences misreport deprivation
names.zh: 森：适应性偏好掩盖匮乏
names.reading: "A reading formed from what the selection has done reads the share, not what lies beyond it; a loss so unread leaves the loop as it was" (the Sen reading is marked the reader's own).

names.en: Fisherian runaway (Lande; Kirkpatrick), read as not the closed lock
names.zh: 费希尔失控选择不是闭合的锁
names.reading: "In the Fisher-Lande setting a viability loss enters the counts that make the share, so Unread fails and that law does not apply."

names.en: Confirmation bias and positive testing (Wason; Klayman and Ha)
names.zh: 确认偏误
names.reading: "Two worlds give one sensed course as long as they answer alike the act taken, so tests a hypothesis predicts cannot refute an over-narrow rule"; "biased weighting is in no law I found".

names.en: Micaiah and the four hundred court prophets (1 Kings 22); unanimity held suspect (b. Sanhedrin 17a)
names.zh: 米该亚与四百宫廷先知：众口一词反而可疑
names.reading: "Readers who live on one source add agreement, not reach": "copied acts carry only the first member's coupling, a majority goes alike where the fewer tell apart".

names.en: 《孟子·滕文公上》許行「賢者與民並耕而食」 and Mencius' reply (the worthy should plough beside the people)
names.zh: 《孟子》：许行并耕之说与孟子的回应
names.reading: "厉 calls a draw a harm; no law says a loss is a harm, and the account classes a draw by whether what it draws on goes on meeting what depends on it"; 通义's rank it does not fix either.

names.en: Coextinction and secondary extinctions (food-web ecology)
names.zh: 共灭与连锁灭绝
names.reading: "Along every chain of total dependence with positive draws the end of one ends everything downstream"; "dependence here is total: what the field measures is mostly partial".

names.en: The gift that binds and moves on (Kimmerer, Braiding Sweetgrass; Mauss, The Gift)
names.zh: 礼物：结下关系，又传下去
names.reading: "One small part has a checked form: giving that waits on giving around a loop, read as the return owed"; "that any actual gift cycle runs these laws is not shown".

names.en: Bhagavad Gītā 3.10-16: the wheel of food, rain and offering
names.zh: 《薄伽梵歌》：食、雨、祭相续之轮
names.reading: "With memory one withholding ends all giving it reaches; without memory it returns round the loop; restoring needs a law in which one gives whatever it waits on."

names.en: Double contingency (Parsons; Luhmann, Soziale Systeme)
names.zh: 双重偶联
names.reading: "Giving that waits on giving stays withheld; without a sparing formation total withholding stays", so "order arises" is scoped: "it needs an actual asymmetry, which is his point, and can fail".

names.en: Whitehead, Process and Reality: an enduring object as a society in serial order
names.zh: 怀特海：持存之物是有序相继的“社会”
names.reading: "Under its premise whatever carries a pattern carried it before or was given it by a carrier"; "nothing is proved of Whitehead, and same form is not same meaning".

names.en: Heraclitus: the one logos by which all comes to be, common to all (DK 22 B1, B2)
names.zh: 赫拉克利特：万物所依、为众所共的逻各斯
names.reading: Here "a law 'is read off what it holds of and does not stand over it'", and "what is common here is formed": "'One' shares a word, not a reference."

names.en: 黄宗羲《明夷待訪錄·田制三》「積累莫返之害」 (taxes merged under one name, the old levies come back on top)
names.zh: 黄宗羲《明夷待访录》：积累莫返之害
names.reading: "The merge loses exactly those distinctions, which return only from a form held outside or by coining; his own book is such a form."

names.en: Sevenfold vengeance, eye for eye, payment, pardon and the other cheek (Genesis 4; Exodus 21; Qur'an 42:40; Matthew 5)
names.zh: 以眼还眼、赔偿与宽恕
names.reading: "A factor above one runs away, one keeps the difference, and a difference closes only through a link giving back less than it received" (placing the texts there is marked the reader's mapping).

names.en: 《老子》七十七章「天之道，損有餘而補不足」 (Heaven's way takes from what has too much and adds to what has too little)
names.zh: 《老子》七十七章：天之道，损有余而补不足
names.reading: Heaven's way is "an exchange opposing the departure from a level on either side, within the gap, settles at the level"; the human way is the lock.

names.en: Purpose as negative feedback (Rosenblueth, Wiener and Bigelow, 1943)
names.zh: 目的就是负反馈（控制论）
names.reading: "The account keeps the loop, with exact laws of opposing exchange, and takes back what it was to explain": "a regulator at its set point protects nothing beyond it by that feedback".

names.en: 《孟子·滕文公下》「天下之生久矣，一治一亂」 (order and disorder in turn), and the five-hundred-year period
names.zh: 《孟子》：天下之生久矣，一治一乱
names.reading: With a bound "it can fail, and 七百有馀 fails it"; "the account gives where returning holds: on m listed configurations under a determined law every course enters what returns".

names.en: A balancing loop with delay oscillates (Forrester, Industrial Dynamics; Senge)
names.zh: 有延迟的调节回路会来回摆荡
names.reading: Overshoot comes "exactly past the gap", and "lag alone does not make a corrective loop oscillate; gain against band does".

names.en: 《左傳·昭公二十年》「寬以濟猛，猛以濟寬」 (leniency corrects severity, severity corrects leniency)
names.zh: 《左传》：宽以济猛，猛以济宽
names.reading: "A step that reverses order within a band ... keeps every course within two values from some step on: alternation for ever, or rest", and "a correction beyond the gap at every step never rests at the mark".

names.en: Epicurus, Principal Doctrines: natural desires end; empty ones run without limit
names.zh: 伊壁鸠鲁：自然的欲望有尽，空洞的欲望无穷
names.reading: "'More than now' cannot rest, and 'above all others' is met by at most one seeker"; "his limit comes from what is desired; the law reads only the target's form".

names.en: 無明 (avidyā), the first link (雜阿含 298經)
names.zh: 无明（《杂阿含经》第298经）
names.reading: "The account takes the name and says something else: seeking locked on a target that cannot be met at rest, nearer 愛 and 取"; the source's not-knowing "is the root to be ended".

written.notes:
I changed no file. The only files I wrote were two read-only query scripts in the scratchpad.

Method. A name was considered for a box when a non-earlier-folders correspondence (correspondences.json, 345 of 1,183 are outside 'earlier-folders') targets a record whose atlas dynamic is in the box's "dynamics" list, or whose dynamic's Lean declarations appear in the box's anchors or in an arrow's laws touching the box. The same was done for the TM pilot files (pilot/zhou.json, daxue.json, wang.json, dialectics.json), through each landing's record and declarations and through the countermodel's declaration. Records are widely shared across dynamics, so the mechanical hits are broad: b1.held had 39 carrying correspondences and a1.within had 49. For each pick I read the reading itself and kept it only where the reading is about what the box's sentence says. Where a reading spans several boxes, I put it at the one its quoted sentence describes. For example, Hardin goes to b0.lost because his mechanism is quoted as "returns to it less than one for one". Escalation and Epicurus go to e2.norest, not b0.lost. Prigogine goes to a1.up because "rises by at most its inflow" matches "a rise always has a giver". 和如羹 and 老子77 both land on two-sided regulation, and I gave e2.good to 老子.

"how" follows the account's relation, adjusted where its own words limit the claim. agreement becomes close. scope becomes within. divergence or contrary-reading becomes not, used only where a reader would expect the name to fit. Two agreement entries I marked within because their readings withhold a half: Jonas ("the other half it withholds") and Fisherian runaway ("agreement of loop shape only"). Hysteresis (cx-dpc-hysteresis) has relation null and no targets. I placed it at a1.past as "not" from its account_adds and absence text. Its one-sided law Flow.never_returns_below sits in loss-of-renewal-for-good, which is on a1.past. Drop it if a target is required.

Provenance to show. Several readings say they are the reader's (AI) own, not the account's: "Proposed here", "my mapping", "my reading". These are Matthew effect, confirmation bias, Sen, talion, Josiah, Collingridge (epistemic horn supposed), Heraclitus logos and Whitehead ("the record says only 'close to'"). The TM entries come from the pilot JSONs in the research folder, not from correspondences.json. The pilot is said to have landed at main 708404bd4, but I did not check that.

Chinese names. Correspondences carry no zh names (name.zh is null throughout), so every zh field above is mine and should be checked by whoever sets the Chinese. Classical sayings are given in the script of their stored source; the zh field uses simplified forms except in titles.

Boxes with no name. Thirteen have no fitting reading: b0.pays, a2.supplied, b1.outside, b1.swing, b2.counted, b3.list, b3.rest, b3.checkers, c1.open, c1.checked, c1.old, c1.nomeans, d2.stalled, d3.several, e1.line, e2.rest, e2.grow. Some of these have mechanical hits that are not about the sentence. Drift/neutral theory and group selection hit b1.outside. Seventh-generation reasoning and Spinoza hit b0.pays. The blind-spot entry hits c1.nomeans. The signifiers file has a proposed coined name 偏蔽，復通 for obscuration-and-reopening (c1.old), but it is a coinage, not a tradition's saying, and its quotation is marked unchecked.

Strong alternates I left out to stay near 45:
- b0.lost: maximum sustainable yield, open access and Clark's optimal depletion (cx-ecoevo-msy-and-open-access, agreement: "others drawing first end the stock at once"), and Moloch/multipolar traps (cx-pal-multipolar-traps, scope).
- e2.norest: Escalation (cx-syscyb-trap-escalation, agreement) and Marx's boundless drive.
- a1.within: Ibn Khaldun on taxation (cx-abr-khaldun-taxation, scope) and the Honorable Harvest.
- d2.handed: Ibn Khaldun's four generations (scope) and Marx's capital (not).
- b2.uncounted: Campbell's law (scope) and HOT (agreement, proposed).
- b0.together: the sabbatical fallow year (not).
- bs.pays: influence-seeking (agreement, proposed).
- b3.gone: 人之有技若己有之 (daxue, scope).
- e2.round: Ecclesiastes, "nothing new under the sun" (scope).
- e2.good: 晏子 和如羹 (zhou, agreement).
- a1.up: Marx, surplus not from circulation (not).
- d3.one: drift and the neutral theory (agreement; a weak fit to the sentence).
- a2.short: autopoiesis (not).

Result: 45 names read. 19 keep, 25 fix, 1 drop. Every source exists under its id. Every reading quote is word for word in its entry.

How I checked. For each name I opened the entry (/Users/ren/theories/theories/becoming/results/atlas/entries/correspondences.json, or the pilot files under /Users/ren/theories/_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/development/tm-traditions-onto-the-map/pilot/), took the records its targets carry, and set their Lean declarations (entries/dynamics.json) against the box's dynamics, anchors, stays and arrows (/Users/ren/theories/tmp/r7/sheet/v2/data/sheet.json, passages.json). Every kept or fixed name has a carried record that is a dynamic of its box or whose law is an anchor or arrow of it. Thinnest ties: Micaiah at c1.same (dynamics list only), Fixes that fail at a2.else (one part of four), Josiah at a2.ended (the reading is about the arrow out).

The rule for "how". I took it from the account's own relation: agreement = close, scope = within, divergence or contrary-reading = not (the three relations are defined in chapters/06-CLASSICAL-TEXTS.md#three-relations; agreement there is expressly not confirmation and does not exhaust the source). Five names were written "within" where the entry says agreement: Ostrom, Jonas, Fisherian runaway (rule read from share), Collingridge, the gift. I set them to close. If you would rather let "within" cover an agreement with stated limits, then apply it alike: Parfit, Whitehead, Matthew, Fixes that fail, Josiah, Sen, Micaiah, talion, Huang and Epicurus carry limits of the same kind, and they were written close. Either way the reading sentence should carry the limit ("agreement of loop shape only", "one small part has a checked form").

The drop. cx-dpc-hysteresis has no targets and no relation (not-carried), and it is out of date: its "no live law states this" predates the-draws-before (Becoming.DrawHistory, landed 10 November), whose record now reads hysteresis onto a law with the limit "it is not shown to be a recovery threshold". cx-cc-congshan-rudeng was corrected for this on 11 November; cx-dpc-hysteresis and the source_adds of cx-ecoevo-alternative-stable-states were not. That is a note for the atlas's owner. DrawHistory is on no box or arrow of the sheet yet.

Sayings. All eleven Chinese sayings are exact in wording against the stored texts under /Users/ren/theories/sources/ (zhou-texts, daxue, wang-yangming, chinese-classical-texts, civilization-thought-v1.0). Script: the Zhou texts, 大學, 王陽明, 黃宗羲 and 雜阿含 are stored in traditional script, as shown. The repository's 《孟子》 and 《老子》 are stored simplified (贤者与民并耕而食; 一治一乱; 损有馀而补不足), so the traditional lines on the English page are the received text's form, not copies of the stored line. Two glyphs: stored 《禮記》 has 盗臣 (the 章句 page 盜臣); stored 《老子》 has 馀 where the zh was written 余. 子產不毀鄉校 is a customary title, not a line of the text, and is rightly shown without quotation marks.

English names of Chinese sources. As written they were wholly in Chinese script, which an English reader cannot recognise. I put a romanised or English title first (Guoyu, Zuozhuan, Shangshu, The Great Learning, Mencius 3A.4 / 3B.9, Laozi 77, Wang Yangming, Huang Zongxi, Saṃyukta Āgama), then the saying in its own script, then the gloss, as the page's existing Huang Zongxi line does.

Reading sentences that need plain words on the map (the quotes are exact, but they carry the model's letters or a Lean name): Stigler ("pay c and receive s"), Mencius ("on m listed configurations"), Fisherian runaway at b3.inside ("Unread fails"). Several quotes are in the first person of the AI reader ("is my mapping", "in no law I found", "the Sen reading is mine"); kept as the entry's own caution, they should be shown as quotation.

Overlap with the boxes' present "known" lines: b0.together and b0.lost (Hardin), b1.held (cumulative advantage), b2.uncounted (Goodhart, popular wording), bs.pays (Stigler). If the names replace those lines, nothing is lost; if both stay, each of these is said twice.

Chinese terms given from memory, to check against the Chinese editions before they stand: 《理与人》 chapter title 道德数学中的五个错误; Senge's archetypes 饮鸩止渴 and 成长上限; 协同灭绝 / 次生灭绝; 《编结茅香》; 双重偶联性.
